tagline: Schedule and cross-post to every major social network from one place.
verdictSummary: The core loop — compose, queue, publish on a schedule — is a real one-sitting build for networks with genuinely open APIs like Bluesky, Mastodon, and Telegram. What isn't buildable is the actual reason Post Bridge exists: one-click posting to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile, all approval-gated behind business verification and app review that an individual often can't even qualify for alone.
coreLoopDIY: Compose posts into a slot-based queue, publish on schedule to networks with open APIs, and fall back to a manual push notification for every approval-gated platform.
whatYouLose: one-click access to approval-gated platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook
pre-approved OAuth apps you likely can't obtain solo
whyPeopleStillPay: The hosted product ships with OAuth apps that major platforms have already put through business verification and app review, turning a multi-week developer-approval process into one click — and it absorbs the constant API churn and token expiry that would otherwise be your job.
notes: The full big-platform set is the moat — the approvals, not the code.
prompt:
Build a personal social post scheduler targeting only networks with genuinely open developer APIs — Bluesky, Mastodon, and a Telegram channel are all realistic starting points. Build a compose view with an image or video attachment and a slot-based queue: define preferred posting times per weekday, and new posts fill the next free slot or get pinned to an exact time. A scheduled job publishes due posts, marking each as sent or failed and retrying briefly before giving up. For platforms people actually want but can't reasonably automate — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn — don't fight their APIs: send yourself a notification with the caption and media at the scheduled time so you can post by hand in under a minute, and be explicit in the UI that this is manual, not automated.

Do not attempt to acquire approval-gated platform access yourself — that needs business verification and app review most individuals don't qualify for solo, and pretending otherwise wastes real effort. Be plain in the README that social APIs drift and this needs occasional patching to stay working.

faq.q: Can I import my existing Post Bridge queue?
faq.a: Not automatically — there's no structured export of scheduled posts. Recreating an active queue by hand is realistic, since it's rarely more than a handful of pending posts.

faq.q: Will it work on my phone?
faq.a: The compose page is a responsive web page, usable on a phone, and the push-notification fallback for gated platforms is specifically designed to be actioned from a phone in under a minute.

faq.q: What does it cost to run?
faq.a: Hosting and a database, typically a few dollars a month — the open-API networks this build targets are free to post to at personal volume.

faq.q: What's the one thing that doesn't survive the rebuild?
faq.a: One-click access to the big platforms. TikTok, Instagram, and the rest stay behind approval processes an individual developer often can't complete alone — this build's honest answer for those is a fast manual post, not real automation.
